title: OpenAlex (scholarly works, authors, institutions)
covers: papers: title, year, authors, venue, DOI, citation counts
query_style: (Responses are turned into readable text by code, with authors in order, before claims are quoted.) A paper title in quotes, an author name, or a DOI. Free-text title search first, then fetch the record by its OpenAlex id.
weak_at: news and anything recent that is not a publication
exact submission days (the arXiv page states them)
time_behavior: Gives publication year and date; a preprint and its journal version can carry different years.
limits: Free daily quota tied to the API key; polite request rate.
